card.name: Newsletter and sign-up page clutter
card.fires_on: Words and punctuation inside website sign-up and subscription prompts, such as newsletter options, 'delivered to your inbox', social media lists and footer text. Mostly general web text, not drug label text.

modes.label: Subscription option lists
modes.description: Dashes or items in lists of ways to receive content like email, RSS, newsletter or social links.
modes.example: Email Newsletter —<< Free>> Magazine — Linkedin Group Julie De

modes.label: Sign-up calls to action
modes.description: Verbs or words in lines urging readers to get updates or join a site.

card.writes: It lowers the odds of words like link, webpage and publication, so it seems to discourage link or publication wording after site-menu text.
card.plain: It notices the newsletter sign-up and share-button clutter found around web articles.
